skill_name: Create an explanatory hypothesis for the given observation.
workflow: I would create an explanatory hypothesis for the observation that more young people are taking up apprenticeships than ever before. My hypothesis would be that the rising cost of college tuition and the lack of available jobs are driving young people to pursue apprenticeships instead.
